text:
Alex: Quick heads up 3 new on-call hires start next week (Mon/Tue). We need to finalize shadow pairings, primary/secondary rotation, and make sure runbook and infra access are done before their first pager.
Tanya: Awesome 4 who are they?
Alex: Emma K. (SF), Priya R. (Berlin), Jonah P. (NYC).
Mike: Suggestion: Emma pairs with me for the first 2 day shifts so I can walk through runtime debugging, mitigations, and the usual playbook. Priya should shadow @Tanya on nights, Jonah with @Sam for the weekend flow.
Tanya: I can take Priya for 3 night shadows and do a 90min deep dive on smart routing, fallback behavior, and cache invalidation steps.
Sam: Heads-up 4 I'll be on PTO Fri+Mon next week so that leaves a gap for the weekend if Jonah isn't ready.
Alex: Two options: (1) accelerate Jonahs shadowing to this week so Sam can hand off before PTO, or (2) schedule a senior to cover that weekend.
Mike: I can cover the weekend if needed but prefer not to. Could Jonah do a practice-run on staging tonight to prove readiness?
incident-bot: [alert] PagerDuty test alert triggered for onboarding verification 4 incident id PD-ONBOARD-2026-67
Emma K.: I'm available this evening 17:00 PT to shadow. Any quick checklist I should follow?
Tanya: Quick onboarding checklist:
- confirm VPN + KMS access
- confirm Redwood Console + token-scoped creds
- run local smoke: `make smoke-test && ./tools/check_latency.sh 512`
- read runbook: https://docs.redwood.example/runbooks/oncall-handoff
- join live shadow: https://meet.redwood.example/oncall-shadow
Mike: Also please use this handoff template when swapping shifts (copy/paste into the rotation channel):
```
Handoff from: <who> (primary)
Handoff to: <who> (primary)
Active incidents: <list or none>
Known degraded services: <service A - impact>
Last deploys in last 24h: <list>
Open follow-ups: <issue numbers>
Recommended next steps: <short bullets>
```
Priya R.: I tried to subscribe to the dedicated GPU pool alerts but got a 403 on the subscription page, can someone grant access?
Alex: @Priya R. - youre added to the alerting group, can you retry?
Priya R.: Confirmed 4 access granted, thanks.
Sam: Jonah 4 can you run the KV cache invalidation sim I posted earlier and verify fallback to CPU path? That's the most common thing to hit in weekend incidents.
Jonah P.: Running the sim on staging now. I forced a prefix miss and saw throughput drop; followed runbook steps and autoscaler launched a burst node after ~90s.
Mike: Expected. Quick commands I use during a live mitigation:
```
# check model queues
kubectl -n inference get pods | grep model-serve
# tail runtime logs
kubectl -n inference logs -f deployment/runtime --since=15m
# force fallback to CPU
redwoodctl route prefer --fallback cpu
```
Tanya: Also make sure new hires are in the Slack oncall channel and on PagerDuty with 2FA. Security ticket #SEC-2026-113 is open to approve that.
Alex: Action items:
- Mike: shadow Emma for first 2 day shifts
- Tanya: shadow Priya for night shifts
- Sam: pair with Jonah this week for practice; Mike to cover weekend if Jonah not ready
- Alex: confirm PagerDuty/Slack/docs access and update runbook with a "new hire shadowing" subsection
- All: run the staging alert test before first real shift
Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept the assignments.
Emma K.: :thumbsup: will join 17:00 PT tonight.
Priya R.: :thumbsup: night shadows confirmed.
Jonah P.: :thumbsup: I'll run the practice test at 21:30 ET.
Mike: :thumbsup:
Tanya: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup: (I'll leave a note on the rotation calendar about my PTO)
Alex: Thanks all 4 I'll post the handoff template to the rotation calendar and add a short "new hire shadowing" checklist in the runbook. If anyone hits access blockers DM me. The first oncall shift should be a learning run, not a firefight.
